title: blob-client: RFC 9404 bindings (Blob/upload, 9404 Blob/get and Blob/lookup)
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B24. Crates: jmap-blob-client. Size: S.

Carried from folded epic JMAP-m4nc (client helpers); see docs/design/blobext.md §8 and §12 Q5 (keep or close). For servers that only advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob (RFC 9404, /data/PROJECT/IETF/specs/rfc9404.txt §4): a separate entry point (e.g. with_blob_legacy_session) reading primaryAccounts[blob], using = core + blob (+ type capabilities), never blob2 in the same request (blobext-03 §2.1); blob_upload over BlobUploadArgs, 9404 Blob/get (properties data/data:asText/data:asBase64/digest:*/size) and Blob/lookup. Acceptance: wiremock tests whose request bodies equal RFC 9404 §4.1.1, §4.2.1 and §4.3.1 requests and whose responses parse those examples; using never contains both URIs; public-api snapshot.
